body:
cant roll on effexor
I have been been takin effexor for four days and the first time it felt like a very mild roll. It made me want to roll because it(effexor) made me feel like I only took half of a tab. So I buy five tabs pop one....wait an hour....pop one more...another hour and one more...barely feel anything...just have the jitters(shivering)...still have about thirty minutes until the third one SHOULD kick in but judging by the others....nothing will happen.
Will post more if I end up feeling any sort of rolling experience.
